string.name: ability_desc
string.value: Copy on one device, paste on another.

string.name: admit_done
string.value: The device is in the group now.

string.name: admit_lead
string.value: On the device to add, choose to join a group, then scan the code it shows.

string.name: admit_make_admin_note
string.value: For a phone that joins as an admin

string.name: admit_paste
string.value: Or paste the code's text, cbb://join…

string.name: alert_admins
string.value: Admins removed or froze each other without seeing it: %s. The root removes one of them.

string.name: alert_cancel_claim_confirm
string.value: Cancel the claim to take the group over?

string.name: alert_claim_pending
string.value: %s claims the group, to take it over from its root.

string.name: alert_claim_pending_left
string.value: %s claims the group, to take it over from its root: it takes effect in %d h.

string.name: alert_claim_stopped
string.value: %s claims the group, and the group is stopped until its root decides.

string.name: alert_claims
string.value: Two claims to take the group over: %s.

string.name: alert_newer
string.value: The group holds records of a later version (%d): update the app to read them.

string.name: alert_secrets_stopped
string.value: The group sends no secrets until its owner decides.

string.name: alert_stopped
string.value: The group is stopped: its devices exchange only their records, no clipboard, until the group's root decides.

string.name: alert_two_histories
string.value: %s signed two histories with one key, as a stolen key or a restore from a backup would.

string.name: alert_void_both_confirm
string.value: Void both histories? The device signs in again only once an admin adds it anew.

string.name: auth_title
string.value: Confirm the change to your group

string.name: away_connected
string.value: Connected to the hub through the tunnel.

string.name: away_connected_hub
string.value: Connected to the hub %s through the tunnel.

string.name: away_connecting
string.value: Connecting to the hub through the tunnel…

string.name: away_dialog_text
string.value: When the phone is not on the home network, it syncs through the WireGuard tunnel of your own hub, a computer of the group set up with cbb global hub; its port is reachable from the internet, but only through WireGuard with the group's keys. The hub answers this phone the next time it connects at home. Nothing goes anywhere else, and without the tunnel there is no connection. Turning it off forgets this phone's tunnel key.

string.name: away_paused
string.value: Everywhere waits while sync is off

string.name: away_waiting
string.value: Waiting for the hub: open the app at home once, near a computer of the group.

string.name: background_reason
string.value: Finishing a copy on its way

string.name: bug_broke_restarted
string.value: Something in CBB broke. It started again.

string.name: bug_text
string.value: Sorry! Allow us to send a short report so that we can fix it? It holds only what broke, the versions of CBB and the system, the device's model and CBB's own records. Your texts, files, keys, device names and addresses are not in it. The report is anonymous.

string.name: device_claim_disputed
string.value: Taking the group over: in dispute, the group's root answered the claim

string.name: device_claim_left
string.value: Taking the group over: waiting, %d h left

string.name: device_claim_none
string.value: Taking the group over: waiting for the group to get the claim

string.name: device_gone
string.value: The device is not in the group any more.

string.name: device_hand_over_confirm
string.value: Hand the group over to this admin? Its claim to take the group over then takes effect at once.

string.name: device_handed_over
string.value: The group is handed over: its claim takes the group at once.

string.name: device_make_admin_confirm
string.value: Make this computer an admin? It may then add and remove devices.

string.name: device_remove_confirm
string.value: Remove this device from the group?

string.name: device_remove_confirm_final
string.value: Remove this device from the group? This cannot be undone: it can come back only as a new device.

string.name: device_take_over_confirm
string.value: Take the group over from its root? Do this only when the root phone is lost: the root sees the claim and can cancel it while the group's waiting time runs.

string.name: device_thaw_confirm
string.value: Unfreeze this admin? The others accept it again.

string.name: error_admit_asks_admin
string.value: That phone asks to be an admin. Only the group's root makes admins; on that phone, join without being an admin.

string.name: error_admit_failed
string.value: The other device did not join.

string.name: error_admit_other_device
string.value: Another device answered at the code's address. Scan the code again.

string.name: error_admit_record
string.value: The device joined, but the group did not take its record yet.

string.name: error_admit_unreachable
string.value: The phone cannot reach the other device. Check that both are on the same Wi-Fi, and that the other device still shows its code.

string.name: error_admit_wrong_code
string.value: The code did not match. Scan the code the other device shows now.

string.name: error_broken
string.value: This build of CBB is broken.

string.name: error_command_refused
string.value: The device did not take the command.

string.name: error_image
string.value: The image could not be read.

string.name: error_invite_expired
string.value: The invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.

string.name: error_invite_failed
string.value: The other phone's group could not be joined. Try again.

string.name: error_invite_no_hub
string.value: The group's hub did not answer. Check that the invitation is still valid and that the hub is on, then try again.

string.name: error_invite_not
string.value: This is not a CBB invitation.

string.name: error_join_listen
string.value: The phone cannot listen for the other device.

string.name: error_join_not_admin
string.value: The other device did not admit this phone as an admin. Only the group's root makes admins: there, admit it as an admin (cbb pair -qr -admin), or join without being an admin.

string.name: error_join_wifi
string.value: Connect the phone to your home Wi-Fi to join a group.

string.name: error_join_wrong_codes
string.value: The other device showed a wrong code three times. Start again.

string.name: error_language
string.value: The language could not be changed.

string.name: error_nfc_off
string.value: NFC is off. Turn it on in the phone's settings, then try again.

string.name: error_no_nfc
string.value: This phone has no NFC, which the YubiKey needs.

string.name: error_not_admin
string.value: Only an admin of the group changes its devices.

string.name: error_not_join_code
string.value: This is not a CBB code. On the other device, choose to join a group, and scan the code it shows.

string.name: error_not_running
string.value: The phone is not connected to its group yet. Try again in a moment.

string.name: error_pasteboard
string.value: The phone's clipboard did not answer.

string.name: error_restore
string.value: The phone could not restore the group.

string.name: error_restore_no_device
string.value: No device of the group was found on this network. Turn on a phone or a computer of the group and try again.

string.name: error_restore_not_key
string.value: This is not the group's recovery key now: the root removed it or made a new one.

string.name: error_restore_not_sheet
string.value: This is not a CBB recovery sheet.

string.name: error_restore_not_sheet_qr
string.value: This is not the QR code of a CBB recovery sheet.

string.name: error_restore_scan
string.value: Scan the QR code of the recovery sheet: on a new phone the typed key is not enough.

string.name: error_save_files
string.value: The files could not be saved.

string.name: error_scan
string.value: The code could not be read.

string.name: error_share
string.value: The phone could not share the invitation.

string.name: error_share_in
string.value: CBB could not read what was shared.

string.name: error_share_nothing
string.value: There is nothing to send: no file could be read.

string.name: error_share_too_large
string.value: The files are too large: up to 50 MB go together.

string.name: error_yubikey
string.value: The YubiKey did not answer as expected. Hold it still against the phone and try again.

string.name: error_yubikey_blocked
string.value: The YubiKey's PIN is blocked. Unblock it with its PUK in Yubico Authenticator, then try again.

string.name: error_yubikey_full
string.value: Every free PIV slot of this YubiKey is in use.

string.name: error_yubikey_management_key
string.value: This YubiKey has its own management key, which the app cannot use. Print a recovery sheet instead.

string.name: error_yubikey_no_key
string.value: This YubiKey holds no recovery key of a group.

string.name: error_yubikey_no_piv
string.value: This card is not a YubiKey with PIV.

string.name: error_yubikey_none
string.value: No YubiKey was held to the phone.

string.name: error_yubikey_old
string.value: This YubiKey is older than firmware 5.7, which the app needs to put a key on it. Print a recovery sheet instead.

string.name: error_yubikey_wrong_pin
string.value: Wrong PIN. After three wrong tries the YubiKey blocks its PIN.

string.name: event_frozen
string.value: %s was frozen: the others refuse it until an admin unfreezes it.

string.name: event_takeover
string.value: %s took the group over: it holds the group's root now.

string.name: hub_bad_forwarder
string.value: Give the forwarder's address with its port and its key, as cbb forward prints them, or leave both empty.

string.name: hub_body
string.value: While the app is open, this phone is the hub of a group without a computer: the other phones, TVs and small devices on the home network connect to it, and with a forwarder they reach it from afar too. The forwarder only passes encrypted packets; it learns the group's tag, this phone's tunnel key and the addresses, never what is copied. A computer that is always on is the better hub; until then this phone does it.

string.name: hub_disguise_body
string.value: For networks that block VPNs or let only the web through; the second needs a connection server that takes VLESS.

string.name: hub_failed
string.value: The forwarder does not take this phone. Check its address and key.

string.name: hub_forwarder_back
string.value: To go back to the project's forwarder, empty both fields and save.

string.name: hub_forwarder_project
string.value: Reached from afar through the project's forwarder at cbb.tools. To use your own, enter its address and key.

string.name: hub_home_only
string.value: The hub at home only: add a forwarder for sync away from home.

string.name: hub_off
string.value: Off: this phone is no hub.

string.name: hub_on_home
string.value: On a home network: devices here connect to this phone.

string.name: hub_registered
string.value: Registered with the forwarder: devices away from home reach this phone.

string.name: hub_stop_only
string.value: The group has no other hub: your devices away from home stop syncing until a device is a hub again. To keep them syncing, make another computer a hub first.

string.name: hub_strict_web
string.value: Networks that let only the web through (VLESS)

string.name: hub_switch
string.value: This phone is the group's hub

string.name: invitation_note
string.value: Join only if you asked for this invitation. Whoever made it admits this phone once they see the words it shows.

string.name: invitation_paste
string.value: Or paste the invitation's text, cbb://invite…

string.name: invitation_scan_lead
string.value: Scan the invitation's QR code, or paste its text.

string.name: invitation_title
string.value: You are invited to a group

string.name: invite_admit_question
string.value: Admit %s (%s)? Admit it only if the device shows the same words:

string.name: invite_done
string.value: %s joined the group; it appears in the list once it connects.

string.name: invite_lead
string.value: On a new phone, open CBB, tap Join with an invitation and scan the code. On a computer, run cbb pair -invite with its text. It works once, until %s.

string.name: invite_opening
string.value: Opening the invitation on the group's hub…

string.name: invite_warning
string.value: Show or send the code only to the person who joins: anyone who has it can ask to join.

string.name: join_admin_lead
string.value: On the group's root phone, add a device, turn on Make it an admin and scan this code; on its root computer, run cbb pair -qr -admin. Keep this screen open.

string.name: join_invite_lead
string.value: Whoever invited you sees these words on their device and admits this phone if they match. Keep this screen open.

string.name: join_joined
string.value: The phone is in the group now.

string.name: join_lead
string.value: On a phone of the group, tap Scan a code and scan this code. On a computer of the group, add a device and type the numbers. Keep this screen open.

string.name: keyboard_body
string.value: This phone types into a TV, a tablet, a console or a computer it is paired with, which needs nothing installed: the clipboard, at your tap, or a remote paste from an admin of the group.

string.name: keyboard_find
string.value: A new device finds this phone by its name in its Bluetooth settings while the keyboard is on.

string.name: keyboard_no_host
string.value: No device is connected. Connect to this phone from the device, in its Bluetooth settings.

string.name: keyboard_no_permission
string.value: CBB may not use Bluetooth yet.

string.name: keyboard_refused
string.value: The phone could not be a keyboard.

string.name: keyboard_too_long
string.value: The text has more than %d characters, more than a keyboard types.

string.name: keyboard_untypeable
string.value: The device's layout has no key for: %1$s. Pick its layout above.

string.name: keyboard_went_away
string.value: The device went away; the text was not typed whole.

string.name: live_added
string.value: The device is in the group.

string.name: main_invitation_in_group
string.value: This phone is in a group already; an invitation is for a new device.

string.name: main_muted
string.value: An admin muted this phone: its copies do not reach the group until an admin unmutes it.

string.name: main_muted_until
string.value: An admin muted this phone until %s: its copies do not reach the group.

string.name: main_off_until
string.value: Off until I turn it on

string.name: main_send_note
string.value: Tap Paste to send what you copied to the group.

string.name: main_show_list
string.value: Show the devices as a list

string.name: module_desc
string.value: Copy on one device, paste on another.

string.name: notify_kind_frozen
string.value: A device is frozen or unfrozen

string.name: notify_kind_takeover
string.value: Another phone takes the group over

string.name: notify_saved
string.value: %d files of the group's copy are ready to save.

string.name: notify_saved_one
string.value: A file of the group's copy is ready to save.

string.name: paste_note
string.value: A paste suits most apps; typing suits those that take no paste, and only up to 4 KB. Enter runs a command in a terminal, so the computer takes it only when its user allowed that. A secret leaves no trace in the computer's log or clipboard.

string.name: paste_on_body
string.value: It goes where %1$s's keyboard focus is, once its user turned remote paste on there.

string.name: paste_pick_note
string.value: A picture or files go to the group as a copy, and the computer pastes them where its focus is, as Ctrl+V would: into a chat, a document or a folder. Enter, if on, sends them in a chat.

string.name: reason_biometric
string.value: To confirm each change to your group with your face, fingerprint or PIN.

string.name: reason_bluetooth
string.value: To act as a Bluetooth keyboard for a TV, a tablet or a computer.

string.name: recovery_has
string.value: The group has a recovery key. With it a computer of the group or a new phone takes the group over if this phone is lost.

string.name: recovery_none
string.value: A recovery key lets a computer of the group or a new phone take the group over if this phone is lost.

string.name: recovery_remove_confirm
string.value: Remove the recovery key? Its sheet stops working.

string.name: recovery_replace_confirm
string.value: Make a new recovery key? The old sheet stops working.

string.name: recovery_write_down
string.value: Write the key down or print this page, and keep it safe. It is shown only once.

string.name: relay_alone
string.value: At the relay: no other device of the group is there now.

string.name: relay_ask_body
string.value: The clipboard stays encrypted end to end between the devices: the relay cannot read it or pose as a device. It does learn, while the devices use it, which devices of the group are online and their internet addresses, and which of them talk to each other, when and how much they send. A hub of the group's own lets none of this out. Use a relay you run yourself, or one whose operator you trust with this.

string.name: relay_bad
string.value: Give the relay's address with its port and its key, as cbb relay prints them, or leave both empty.

string.name: relay_body
string.value: For a group without a hub of its own: the devices meet at a relay, such as one set up with cbb relay, while the app syncs. The clipboard stays encrypted between the devices, but the relay learns which of them are online and their addresses, and which talk to each other, when and how much. Leave both fields empty to stop.

string.name: relay_failed
string.value: The relay does not take this phone. Check its address and key.

string.name: relay_off
string.value: Off: this phone meets nobody at a relay.

string.name: relay_paused
string.value: Waiting: the relay works while the app syncs.

string.name: relay_with
string.value: At the relay; devices of the group there: %1$d.

string.name: remote_paste_body
string.value: An admin of the group then types a text through this phone into the device it is connected to, from its own app or with cbb paste. This phone shows who pasted, and keeps a log of the last pastes without their text.

string.name: remote_paste_enter_note
string.value: A text with a line break needs it too: the keyboard types a line break as Enter.

string.name: remote_paste_switch
string.value: Let the group's admins paste there

string.name: restore_claimed
string.value: The group is restored on this phone. It becomes the group's root once the group's waiting time passes, unless the root cancels the claim.

string.name: restore_claimed_left
string.value: The group is restored on this phone. It becomes the group's root when the waiting time ends, %d h from now, unless the root cancels the claim.

string.name: restore_lead
string.value: Scan the QR code of the group's recovery sheet. Keep a phone or a computer of the group turned on and on this network.

string.name: restore_paste
string.value: Or paste the code's text, cbb://recover…

string.name: restore_restoring
string.value: Looking for a phone or a computer of the group on this network…

string.name: restore_root
string.value: This phone is the group's root now.

string.name: settings_delay
string.value: A claim to take the group over waits

string.name: settings_error_details_note
string.value: Puts the error itself under each error message

string.name: settings_key_level_below
string.value: Some admins keep weaker keys; they stay until removed

string.name: settings_leave_confirm
string.value: Leave the group on this phone? The group lists it until an admin removes it.

string.name: settings_leave_root_confirm
string.value: Leave the group and delete its root key? Without a recovery key or another admin nobody can manage the group any more.

string.name: start_invitation_note
string.value: For a group far away: scan or paste the invitation you got.

string.name: start_join_admin
string.value: Join a group as an admin

string.name: start_join_admin_note
string.value: For a second phone that can manage the group if the first one is lost.

string.name: start_join_note
string.value: A phone or a computer of the group scans this phone's code.

string.name: start_lead
string.value: Copy on one device, paste on another.

string.name: start_new_group_note
string.value: This phone becomes the group's root: it admits your computers and confirms each change with your face, fingerprint or PIN.

string.name: start_restore_note
string.value: When the group's root phone is lost.

string.name: takeover_cancelled_admin
string.value: The group's root cancelled the claim; the phone stays an admin.

string.name: takeover_cancelled_restore
string.value: The group's root cancelled the claim to restore the group.

string.name: takeover_void_admin
string.value: The claim to take the group over became void; the phone stays an admin.

string.name: takeover_void_restore
string.value: The claim to restore the group became void.

string.name: tip_lost_text
string.value: Make a second phone an admin: on it, tap Join a group as an admin, then scan its code here with Scan a code. Tap to close.

string.name: watch_admin_body
string.value: With a key of its own, the watch can freeze an admin computer, remove a device that is no admin, and turn remote paste, quick actions and sync away from home off. It needs a screen lock, and its on-wrist detection should be on.

string.name: watch_made_admin
string.value: The watch is an admin now. It can freeze an admin computer, remove a device that is no admin and turn things off.

string.name: watch_not_protected
string.value: The watch needs a screen lock. Set one on the watch, keep it on your wrist, then try again.

string.name: watch_not_reachable
string.value: The watch did not answer. Is it connected to this phone, with CBB installed?

string.name: watch_replace
string.value: To give a new watch the key, remove this one from the devices first.

string.name: why_alone_d
string.value: Turn on another device of the group.

string.name: why_alone_t
string.value: Connected, but no other device of the group is online.

string.name: why_away_off_d
string.value: Turn on Everywhere to sync away from home.

string.name: why_away_off_t
string.value: No device of the group is on this network.

string.name: why_cert_ending_d
string.value: Connect it at home to a trusted device of the group before then.

string.name: why_cert_expired_d
string.value: Bring it home to a trusted device of the group, which renews the certificate.

string.name: why_entries_stale_d
string.value: Update CBB on a computer of the group.

string.name: why_entries_stale_t
string.value: The list of the connection servers' entry points is out of date.

string.name: why_forwarder_down_d
string.value: Devices away from home may not reach it; CBB tries again by itself.

string.name: why_forwarder_down_t
string.value: The connection server does not take this base.

string.name: why_frozen_d
string.value: Ask the group's owner to restore its rights.

string.name: why_frozen_t
string.value: This device's rights as a trusted device are paused.

string.name: why_hub_unreachable_d
string.value: Check that the base is on and online.

string.name: why_hub_waiting_d
string.value: Check that the other devices have Everywhere on.

string.name: why_hub_waiting_t
string.value: This device is the base, and no device has connected yet.

string.name: why_muted_d
string.value: Unmute it from a trusted device of the group.

string.name: why_muted_t
string.value: This device is muted: its copies do not reach the group.

string.name: why_muted_until_t
string.value: This device is muted until %1$s: its copies do not reach the group.

string.name: why_new_network_d
string.value: If this is your home network, mark it as home.

string.name: why_new_network_t
string.value: This computer has not met its group on this network.

string.name: why_newer_t
string.value: The group has records of a newer version.

string.name: why_no_hub_d
string.value: Make a computer at home the base, in its advanced settings.

string.name: why_no_hub_t
string.value: Everywhere is on, but the group has no base.

string.name: why_not_in_group_d
string.value: Start a group or join one.

string.name: why_not_in_group_t
string.value: This device is in no group.

string.name: why_only_device_d
string.value: Add a phone or a computer.

string.name: why_only_device_t
string.value: This is the group's only device.

string.name: why_relay_down_d
string.value: Check the internet connection; CBB tries again by itself.

string.name: why_relay_down_t
string.value: The backup server does not answer.

string.name: why_removed_d
string.value: Leave the group on this device, then join again.

string.name: why_removed_t
string.value: This device was removed from the group.

string.name: why_secrets_stopped_t
string.value: The group sends no secrets until its owner decides.

string.name: why_stopped_d
string.value: The group's owner decides on its alerts.

string.name: why_stopped_t
string.value: The group's records stop the exchange.

string.name: why_sync_off_t
string.value: Sync is off on this device.

string.name: why_sync_off_until_t
string.value: Sync is off on this device until %1$s.

string.name: why_taken_over_d
string.value: If this device was not lost, remove %1$s from the group.

string.name: why_taken_over_t
string.value: %1$s took the group over from this device.

string.name: why_tunnel_blocked_d
string.value: This network may block tunnels: turn on Strict networks on the base.

string.name: why_tunnel_blocked_t
string.value: The tunnel to the base %1$s does not get through.

string.name: why_unreached_d
string.value: Let CBB through this computer's firewall.

string.name: why_unreached_t
string.value: Devices at home cannot connect to this one: %1$s.

string.name: widget_description
string.value: Opens CBB and sends what this phone copied to your computers, or fetches what a computer copied a moment ago.

string.name: yubikey_hold
string.value: Hold the YubiKey to the back of the phone until this message goes.

string.name: yubikey_hold_again
string.value: Found the group. Hold the YubiKey to the phone again to sign the claim.

string.name: yubikey_made
string.value: The recovery key is on the YubiKey. Keep it away from this phone; a recovery sheet made before no longer works.

string.name: yubikey_put_body
string.value: The YubiKey makes the key in a free PIV slot, and the key never leaves it. Nothing else on the YubiKey changes. Restoring then needs the YubiKey, its PIN and a tap. A YubiKey with its own management key is not supported here: use the sheet instead.

string.name: yubikey_put_title
string.value: Put the recovery key on a YubiKey

string.name: yubikey_restore_body
string.value: Keep this phone on the network of a computer of the group. You hold the YubiKey to the phone twice: once to find the group, once to sign the claim. This phone becomes the group's root when the group's waiting time ends, unless the old phone cancels it.
